WITH behavior_trans AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg
),
mix_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM behavior_trans
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as distinct_mixes,
    SUM(cnt) as total_count
  FROM mix_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    mc.ordertypedist as mix,
    mc.cnt as count,
    CAST(mc.cnt AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
    1.0 / s.distinct_mixes as avg_share
  FROM mix_counts mc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT 
  mix,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
